coverageEvidence.excerpt: Manufacturing feasibility, immunogenicity and clinical benefit are different endpoints. An immune assay needs its stated cell population, supplied antigen, controls, sampling time and response definition. Reactivity in blood to added peptide does not by itself establish recognition of naturally processed targets on cancer cells; recognition in a model does not establish fewer recurrences. A clinical comparison needs the population, accompanying treatments, endpoint, follow-up and harms. A positive result at one level cannot substitute for the next.
